column1: # op1-pots.tsv — the machine-readable half of decisions/OP-1.md.
# The ruling is the source; this file is the same twelve rows in the shape admission reads them in,
# and acceptance/v04-budget.sh holds the two against each other on every run. A number in one that
# is not in the other is drift, and the run fails — the same rule OP-5 and op5-policy.tsv stand
# The three rules the ruling states generate the table, and the script checks them too:
#   tokens       = 8000 * pod_minutes        (a pod minute is worth eight thousand tokens)
#   money_micros = 5 * tokens                (5 EUR per million tokens)
#   the principal_channel_day row binds pod minutes only — SP-T01-8 asks for a limit in pod
#   minutes, so its token and money caps are the principal_day ones and can never refuse first.
# It is embedded into the binary (go:embed): admission runs where the halt file is read and the
# state database answers, and a cap that had to be fetched would be a cap that is absent exactly
#   pot  LEVEL         SCOPE                  POD_MINUTES  TOKENS     MONEY_MICROS
